title: Next epic: bundle small 43y follow-ups and run it in the cloud as the A4/A2 run
description:
The tick asks for the next feasible epic. hn6 is already running locally, so it is not available. umq's remaining dax changes the container path and deletes the rollout grace period the runbook's deploy fault relies on, so it is a poor host for the demonstration. Proposal: a small epic of GLM-suitable 43y backlog ticks (3sd, 8wa, 2p3, 96s, q6z, gzw, qzg), planned with [A<n>] items and a command per item, run with `ticfac run <id> --cloud` after the 43y deploy. One cloud run then observes 43y's [A4] cloud half and [A2] real-run faults, and dha's u9h gate run too if the Workflow is restarted mid-run. u9h's only open blocker is the yoh epic record, whose 25 ticks are all closed. Precondition: the GitHub App rung live for this repository.
evidence: git log -1 origin/epic/hn6 (hn6 gating qjl); .tick/issues/u9h.json (blocked_by yoh only open); docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md:47-62

ticfac run epic-43y created this tick by absorbing the finding f02cdbffff50217eb6c35194efe14d631a9c99be0d452581b8d23362de5048d6 (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-j2k/attempt-69): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/f02cdbffff50217eb6c35194efe14d631a9c99be0d452581b8d23362de5048d6.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-06 01:37 - ticfac run epic-43y: created by absorbing finding f02cdbffff50217eb6c35194efe14d631a9c99be0d452581b8d23362de5048d6 — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/f02cdbffff50217eb6c35194efe14d631a9c99be0d452581b8d23362de5048d6.json on epic/43y, and it says: the classifier put 0.54 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A4: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
